positioning: Read-only independent QA review of the perworld L v2 criteria entity card cde3e597 against signed spec v3 sections 4/5/6/8/10.1, with an independent criterion-C recompute on the retained G-L0 pilot reference, independent dumper re-run, forced-ignored gating check and the four gates. GPU-free, no capture, no window.

verdict.blocking_summary: F1: criterion C1 counts byte-quantized |delta byte| >= 1 instead of the signed section 6 f32 max_channel|delta rgb| >= 1/255; on the G-L0 pilot reference this yields 43,604/41,815 vs 38,285/40,644 (+5,319/+1,171, all 254<->255 saturation-boundary steps). Verdict does not flip on this reference (all counts >> 576) but the counting rule deviates from the signed object and leans permissive; fix before freezing the G-L2 executable.
verdict.g_l2_freeze: conditional: fix F1 (and preferably O2) before the G-L2 frozen-exe freeze; the rest of the entity is ready
verdict.other_findings: none: A strict-bit-level without allowlist/tolerance, C2 exact, camera attribution fixed and non-swappable, diagnostics recorded only, gating explicit, dump reproducible, boundaries and four gates clean
